subject: The secret mistake 90% of users make with screenshots
preview_text: One user discovered this buried feature and it changed everything. You're probably skipping it too.
body_paragraphs: Got a text from a user last week that stopped me cold. She said she was about to delete the app. Thought it wasn't working for her. Said she'd scanned a few conversations, saw some yellow flags, but nothing clicked. Then she found the one thing almost everyone misses.

She was looking at individual messages like snapshots. Isolated moments. But toxicity isn't a single sentence—it's a pattern. It's the slow drip of doubt over weeks. The subtle shift in tone you can't quite pinpoint. She was scanning the trees and missing the entire poisoned forest.

Buried in the dashboard is a feature called 'Pattern Connect.' It doesn't just scan one screenshot. It links your last 5, 10, 20 scans together. Shows you the trajectory. Maps the escalation. That user? She uploaded 8 conversations from the last two months. The AI connected the dots she couldn't see: the love-bombing peak in week 2, the gradual withdrawal by week 6, the gaslighting attempts that increased every time she expressed a need. The single scans showed 'moderate concern.' The pattern scan screamed 'get out.'

Open the app right now. Go to your dashboard. Tap 'View Pattern History.' Upload at least 3 recent conversations. Let the AI show you what you're missing in the spaces between messages. P.S. The most dangerous red flags are the ones you normalize over time. This feature shows you the normalization happening in real-time.
